name: Venice
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Venice?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes. Plain golf carts only on roads the city designates, and no Venice designation was found, so plain golf carts show red on public roads. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less in Venice.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections
No golf-cart street designation was found in the city code

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Venice?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Venice?
faq.a: Only on a street the city has designated and signed. We did not find any, so plan on a registered LSV.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on the island streets in Venice?
faq.a: Yes, where they are posted 35 mph or less.
